note: Small, secluded campground in a grove of red and white pines along the Little Isabella River, a brook-trout stream, 4.5 mi W of Isabella. The Forest Service says the spurs are not designed for RVs and some may not suit one; no site lengths are posted, so fit for a 23-ft rig is unconfirmed. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov/RIDB read: 11 back-in non-electric sites (7-11 reservable, 1-6 FCFS; 1-4 also long-term seasonal at $504), $18 in 2026 and 2027, half-fee extra vehicle, 9 people, 14 nights, vault toilets, season May 8 - Oct 1. No posted site lengths. Not in the post-wildfire closure order. Not waterfront kept. Pin and phone confirmed.
flags: FIT (no posted lengths): RIDB lists no Max Vehicle Length or Driveway Length on any site, and both FS and rec.gov say 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Most can accommodate a moderately sized vehicle, some may not be suitable for an RV.' The same wording appears on other Superior NF pages (agency boilerplate), so it is not a drop; the old note's 'most sites fit small RVs to ~24 ft' had no source and is replaced by a caveat. No review with a 23 ft+ rig was searched for.

DRINKING WATER conflict: the FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site' but its own rules and rec.gov say 'Water faucets are for drinking water only' and rec.gov lists 'Drinking Water', 'Water (Seasonal)', 'Water Spigot'. potable_water left unset.
CATALOG vs prose: rec.gov/FS say the sites are 'pull-in'; the RIDB catalog types all 11 'Back-in'. pull_through false written from the catalog.
LONG-TERM sites: 4 of 11 sites (1-4) are offered for seasonal long-term camping at $504 May 1 - Oct 30 (federal campground; nightly sites remain). Information only.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the Little Isabella River is a narrow stream (well under 30 m; creekside at most). On Esri imagery the nearest site points (11 at 47.64859,-91.42658; 10 at 47.64832,-91.42608; 9 at 47.64826,-91.42577) sit roughly 25-35 m south of the stream under continuous red-pine canopy, with no open ground to the bank. rec.gov's 'All sites are private and close to the water' is marketing prose. No change.
Pin 47.6480,-91.4246 is at the centroid of the rec.gov site points (47.64808,-91.42465); FS page point 47.64686,-91.42313 is ~170 m SE toward the entrance. No move.
PHONE 218-663-8060 confirmed (FS Tofte Ranger District; rec.gov 'please call (218) 663-8060'). Websites current.
STATUS: FS page shows 'Closed - No fees or services' (ordinary end of season). Not named in post-wildfire closure order 09-09-00-26-11 Exhibit A (Gunflint, Kawishiwi and LaCroix BWCAW sites only).

EQUIPMENT: RIDB lists no permitted equipment on any site (no RV, trailer or fifth-wheel type), so the Availability page's EKKO filter will show no site here. FS lists the sites under 'RV Camping'; same Superior NF pattern as McDougal and Ninemile.
